The '''Aratech droid oxidizer''' was an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]] developed by the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Company]] to be effective against a range of opponents in order to eliminate the need to carry a separate anti-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapon. While ion weapons such as the droid oxidizer were generally less damaging against organic opponents, they were able to penetrate some defenses that would have blocked typical [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, and as such saw use against [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].
